hero.title: Lan Wei
hero.description:
I am a PhD student in the Multi-Scale Embodied Intelligence Lab at Imperial College London, advised by Dr. Dandan Zhang. My research focuses on diffusion-based sim-to-real image generation and efficient vision–language–action (VLA) models, with the goal of enabling reliable and data-efficient robot perception and control.

Previously, I earned my M.E. in Computer Science from the University of Science and Technology of China (USTC) in 2024, and my B.E. in Computer Science from Xiamen University in 2021.

data.summary: Three papers has been accepted to IROS 2026. Thanks all collaborators!
One paper on diffusion model acceleration has been accepted to ICML 2026 (Acceptance rate: 26.6%).
Two papers have been accepted to MARSS 2026.
Honored to receive the 2026 Early Career Development Grant from the Imperial I-X Women in AI Network (IX-WAI).
Congratulations to the Master's students I co-supervise with Dr Dandan Zhang on having four papers accepted to ICRA 2026.
Happy to got the IROS 2025 IEEE RAS Travel Support Award with the amount of $1500 USD.
One paper is accepted at the IEEE International Conference on Cyborg and Bionic Systems (CBS 2025), and nominated for the Best Paper Award.
Our paper won the Best Student Paper Award with the highest score at MARSS 2025.
Our paper on patch clamp multi-pipette localisation is accepted at IROS’2025.
Our paper about Microrobots Dataset is accepted at MARSS’2025, and nominated for the Best Paper Award.
I joined Imperial College London as a PhD student (full scholarship).
I successfully graduated from the University of Science and Technology of China!
